SEMIS (audited 26/37/37, deeper and trend break co-modal; hinge SOXX 497.40, trend 465) is a weak constraint at the 1y ratio 0.57: SOXX 497.40 ~ NVDA 216.0, SOXX 465 ~ 208.1, SOXX 435-455 ~ 200.8-205.7; this is where NVDA can decouple (Jun 22-Jul 29: NVDA -8.9% vs SOXX -29.0%), mapped ~42/46/12 - but at the 5y ratio of 1.0 (catch-down) SOXX 465 ~ 198 and 435-455 ~ 185-194. scenarios.name: shallow pullback
scenarios.definition: Lowest NVDA daily close from Oct 15 through Fri Dec 4 (to ~Dec 9 if the print is Nov 25) stays >= 210.00 (holds the 210.2-211.0 Mar-30 AVWAP / 61.8% Fib / Sep 14 close / 6m POC cluster).
scenarios.timeframe: Oct 15-23 (TSMC Oct 15, opex Oct 16, META/LRCX/VIX expiry Oct 21); Oct 29 at the latest
scenarios.path: TSMC beat holds green through Oct 16 opex; NVDA holds 214.45; META capex accepted Oct 21; close >223.21 by Oct 23; Oct 28 FOMC hold + MSFT/GOOGL capex up with their stocks up; close >230.48 before the print; retest 235.74-239.24 into the print.
scenarios.confirming_signals: Closes >=214.45 through Oct 21; close >223.21 by Oct 23; NVDA/SOXX not down >5% in a week; SOXX holds 497.40 and QQQ holds 697; VIX/VIX3M <0.95; HY OAS <=3.25%.

scenarios.path: 214.45 then 210 break between Oct 16-28 as SOXX loses 497.40 and QQQ tests 680-700; the Oct 28 cluster punishes capex and/or keeps the Fed hawkish; NVDA tags 201-207 (rising 200d ~203-205, YTD AVWAP 200.85, 78.6% Fib, range low 206.64) on a vol spike (VIX/VIX3M >=0.95); recovery to 215-225 into the print.

scenarios.name: trend break
scenarios.definition: Lowest NVDA daily close in the window is < 190.01 (new lower low below the Jul 29 closing low, consistent with the upper layers' Jul-29-low trend lines).

distinguishing_evidence: Oct 15-16: does a TSMC beat close green and hold, and does NVDA hold 214.45 through Oct 16 opex (220 pin)? Oct 21-23: close >223.21 favours shallow; close <210 before Oct 23 makes deeper the base case; close <200.85 before Oct 28 = acceleration toward trend break. Oct 28-29: hyperscaler reaction function - capex up with the spender's stock up (July MSFT/AMZN pattern) vs down (GOOGL/META pattern); FOMC hike or hold. Watch NVDA's down-day ratio to SOXX: staying ~0.6 = holdout intact (caps NVDA near 208 even if SOXX breaks 465); rising toward 1.0 = catch-down (trend-break path). November: credit channel (CoreWeave ~Nov 10, CoreWeave 2032 bond price vs 75c, any new NVDA guarantees, OpenAI round) and the NVDA print (unannounced, Nov 17-25): Q4 guide ~$120bn+, GM trough holds 71-72%, FY28 ~+70% reaffirmed, no new guarantees. Shallow vs deeper is also told apart by whether SOXX holds 497.40 and QQQ holds 697.
strongest_bull_points: NVDA is the relative refuge (NVDA/SOXX +33.7% since Jun 22; Jun 22-Jul 29 NVDA -8.9% vs SOXX -29%); at the 1y ratio 0.57 even a SOXX break of 465 maps only to ~208. 5 of 11 three-year record-close episodes that hit -7.5% ended at -7.6% to -9.7% and bottomed within 0-3 sessions (confirmed). Dense 214.5-218.9 shelf (100d, 50% Fib, Sep 17 gap, 3m POC) and 210.2-211.0 cluster below. Holdout signal sets show 42-47% shallow outcomes. NVDA lows have not needed volume capitulation (0.96-1.05x at the last three lows). Fundamentals accelerating (Q3 guide $108bn, FY28 ~+70% supply-constrained, TSMC Q3 revenue +50.9% y/y), ~15x FY28 (MS), $235bn buyback authorization, no downgrades/insider sales. Hike odds fell to 24-32%; market layer modally shallow; midterm Q4 seasonality; DB analog 40d median +6.5% (76% positive).
strongest_bear_points: Overnight print (218.35-218.96) already sits only 3.8-4.1% above the 210 hinge; 3y episodes conditioned on the overnight -8.7% are 33/44/22 and 5y 25/50/25; every base rate and the implied-vol random walk (30/44/26 from 218.25) put >=55% below 210. Tech (binding constraint) gives 63% that QQQ closes <697, which maps to NVDA <~208. The low beta to SOXX is a 1-year regime (5y ratio 1.01 on big SOXX down days) - catch-down maps the semis trend break (37% after audit) to NVDA 185-194. Failed breakout above 235.74; semis lower high and 14% breadth. Credit stress runs through NVDA's own balance sheet ($105bn/$108.5bn guarantees, $279bn commitments, AI labs ~1/4 of next year's business; CoreWeave 2032s <78c). No index vol capitulation; crowded semis positioning; NVDA buyback window likely closed (unverified). NVDA print in-window with 7 of last 9 prints lower 5 sessions later; hiking Fed with real yields at 2008 highs; DB analog median 20d/40d MAE ~203.4/199.6.
verdict_most_likely_bottom_zone: Deeper correction: lowest close 201-209 (centred 203-207; median lowest close ~205-207), i.e. -5.6% to -9.2% from 221.30 (-4.3% to -7.9% from the ~218.35 overnight print) and -12.6% to -16.0% from the 239.24 record close; most likely formed Oct 28 - Nov 6, with the NVDA print week as a secondary window. Probabilities: shallow 33 / deeper 47 / trend break 20.
verdict_confidence: Medium-low (~47% that the lowest close falls in 190.01-210; ~33% that it lands in the narrower 198-209 zone). Why: all independent lenses (episode conditionals, 36-session signal sets, implied-vol walk, top-down mappings) put the mode in the deeper bucket, but samples are small and overlapping (effective n ~6-10), shallow vs deeper hinges on a level only ~4% below the overnight print, holdout outcomes are bimodal, and the NVDA earnings date (unannounced) and TSMC results (pending at write time) can move it.
single_most_important_level: NVDA 210 on a closing basis (210.21-211.02 cluster: Mar-30 AVWAP, 61.8% Fib 210.39, Sep 14 close 210.96, 6m POC 211.02; Nov max pain ~210) - separates shallow from deeper and is the bull's own invalidation. Secondary: 190.01 (Jul 29 close, trend line); upside confirmation 230.48.
single_most_important_event: Wed Oct 28: FOMC decision 2:00 pm ET (hike odds 24-32% late Oct 14) followed by MSFT and GOOGL capex after the close (hyperscalers = 55% of NVDA's Q2 Data Center revenue). Second: NVDA's own Q3 FY27 print (date unannounced, Nov 17-25). First test: TSMC Q3 (Oct 15).
what_would_change_verdict: Toward shallow (>45%): a TSMC green close that holds plus an NVDA close >223.21 by Oct 23 without losing 214.45, or a close >230.48 before Oct 28; MSFT/GOOGL capex up with their stocks up. Toward trend break (>30%): a close <200.85 before Oct 28; NVDA/SOXX down >5% in a week while SOXX <497.40 (catch-down); HY OAS >3.46% or CoreWeave 2032s <75c; Oct 28 hike with hawkish guidance; a new NVDA credit-support commitment; QQQ <683.7 before Oct 28. TSMC rules: Q4 guide up q/q, GM >=~65%, capex >=$60-64bn and NVDA close >=216.7 holding through Oct 16 -> shallow up to ~40%; flat/down guide, 'digestion' language, or a faded beat with NVDA <214.45 -> deeper/trend up.
